checklist.why: Purpose plus 'use Segment instead for fixed views and list states'.
When/when-not present; names Segment, ChoiceList, Button.
Scroll track, chip, label, count, check, reason named and shown.
One variant (tags), used by Piglet processing's pen list.
Pressed uses --press (#f1f5eb) on --well chips (#eef1e7): invisible on an unselected chip; the demo presses the selected chip, which then looks unselected.
Chips 48px tall, narrowest 63px (All) at 390; token gap between chips.
States no cap by design: the dynamic set scrolls; the demo shows 7 with overflow.
Selected = check mark + weight + paper face; disabled = dashed outline + reason.
Wrap rules and a Chinese long-label example render without clipping; the content rules themselves are copied from Segment ('2-3 choices', '4-5') and do not fit chips.
radiogroup/radio/aria-checked, roving tabindex, arrows/Home/End give a non-swipe path through the scroll.
New .st-filter-chips rules use tokens; listed in the README.
Links Segment, ChoiceList, IconButton; TaskChips stated as an adapter; classified component.
Six states rendered at 375; only intentional horizontal scroll (cgate/FilterChips/).

variants.name: tags (single-select job filter with counts)
findings: Done is out of the chip row and is now a Segment lens state; the All chip dropped its count (the To do count carries it); chips hide under the Done lens. All as briefed.

findings.text: Press feedback is invisible on an unselected chip (--press vs --well differ by 3-4 RGB); pressing the selected chip strips its paper face so it reads as deselected.
findings.fix: Press unselected chips with a darker token (--choice-press or a new --press-on-well); leave the selected chip's face alone; demo Pressed on an unselected chip.

findings.text: The hidden check keeps its 16px slot on unselected chips (visibility:hidden), so labels sit right of centre ('   Iron 6') and every chip is 16px wider than its content.
findings.fix: Collapse the check on unselected chips (display:none) and accept the small width change on select, or draw the check inside the chip's left padding.

findings.text: README content rules and do/don't are copied from Segment ('≤12 characters at 2-3 choices; ≤8 at 4-5', 'name subjects consistently') and do not describe a scrolling tag set.
findings.fix: State chip rules: 1-2 word job names, a character cap per chip, one count per tag, All first and without a count when a lens above carries the total.

findings.text: Demo data is incoherent: All shows 2 while Iron shows 3 and Weight 8; the real screen omits All's count.
findings.fix: Demo All without a count (as Piglet does) or with a total at least every tag's count.
